consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on TK-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on TK-7104 and PSV-7104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. TK-7104 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 22 August 2024 a corrective action on TK-7104 and PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
